crossRefs.note: Being therefore justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ;
“There is no peace”, says my God, “for the wicked.”
They don’t know the way of peace; and there is no justice in their ways. They have made crooked paths for themselves…
How narrow is the gate, and restricted is the way that leads to life! Few are those who find it.
to shine on those who sit in darkness and the shadow of death; to guide our feet into the way of peace.”
